fragments.line: Before the streets were named, the ground was already spoken for.
What you walk on is a lid. What it covers has been counting your steps.
Seven marks, and the seventh is the one that was always missing from you.
A door is a wall that has decided to be reasonable. This one has not decided yet.
You will know the place by how the geometry leans toward it, like grass toward a drain.
Do not bring a light. It has one. It would rather you saw by that.
When the star closes, so does the argument. Walk to where it points and stop pretending you have a choice.

inscription: Before the streets were named, the ground was already spoken for. What you walk on is a lid — and what it covers has been counting your steps. There are seven marks, and the seventh is the one that was always missing from you. A door is a wall that has decided to be reasonable; this one has not decided yet. You will know the place by how the geometry leans toward it, the way grass leans toward a drain. Do not bring a light — it has one, and it would rather you saw by that. When the star closes, so does the argument.
